title: Lean spaghetti bolognese
steps: Chop the onion, grate the carrot and crush a clove of garlic.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat, add the mince and break it up with a spoon. Fry for 5 to 6 minutes until browned all through with no pink left.
Add the onion, carrot and garlic and cook for 3 minutes until soft.
Stir in the tomatoes and a pinch of dried herbs, cover and simmer gently for 15 minutes, stirring now and then. Add a splash of water if it gets too thick, and season with salt and pepper.
Meanwhile cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water as the pack says (usually 10 to 12 minutes) and drain it.
Serve the sauce on the spaghetti.
